author: SickProdigy
description: Grabs information from Clash of Clans API
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
install_msg: Set the bot-wide Clash of Clans key with `[p]set api clashofclans api_key,YOUR_KEY`, then use `[p]cocset clan <clan_tag>` for each server.
